description: This file defines the AppListViewModel class and related classes for managing and providing a list of launchable applications in an Android environment, including live data handling and broadcast receivers for app package changes.

classes.name: AppListViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that provides a list of launchable activities, manages live data, and handles receiver registration.

classes.name: AppListLiveData
classes.description: LiveData subclass that asynchronously loads and updates the list of installed launchable apps.

classes.name: PackageIntentReceiver
classes.description: BroadcastReceiver that listens for package-related system events and triggers data reloads.

methods.name: AppListViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing live data and broadcast receiver.

methods.name: getAppList
methods.description: Returns LiveData containing the list of AppEntry objects.

methods.name: onCleared
methods.description: Unregisters the broadcast receiver when ViewModel is cleared.

methods.name: AppListLiveData
methods.description: Constructor initializing package manager and loading app data.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of launchable apps.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Background task querying package manager for launchable activities.

methods.name: onPostExecute
methods.description: Updates live data with the loaded app list if data version matches.

methods.name: PackageIntentReceiver
methods.description: Constructor registering for package change events and external app availability.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles broadcast events by triggering data reload.
